# Genealogy society record transfer

The Tamarack Valley Genealogical Society keeps its burial index and family files at the county historical society, not at the library. This year the society moved those records from a desktop database to a hosted system shared with two neighboring counties.

The move went badly at first. Dates entered as text came over blank, about 900 family files were merged with unrelated families of the same surname, and volunteers spent a month fixing links between people. The society now checks a sample of records after every import.

Library staff sometimes refer patrons to the society for family research, but the library holds none of these records.
